paragraphs.text: Clamhattan is a non-canon planar subtype that debut on a playtest card at the 2024 Amsterdam Planechase Unknown event.

Clamhattan debuted as a type on Clamilton Estate at the 2024 Amsterdam Planechase Unknown event and was re-printed for the 2024 Las Vegas event. It is potentially part of the Un-iverse and the home plane of the Clamfolk , including Alexander Clamilton . The Clamilton Estate may be Alexander's family home. The estate supports the wordy nature of its clamfolk owner.
